title: Bounties System
description: Best bounty plugin for your economy server.
body:
Bounties System For PaperMC Minecraft

Ever wanted to make bounties on your server? Well this plugin will be the best for your economy because of the easy and quick use of this plugin! When you set a bounty you can see who it is on and how much. When you kill that player you will recieve the money!

/topbounties to see top bounties
/bounty set <name> <price> to set bounty
/bounty <player> to view bounty of player
